description: Jira client whose output is a versioned contract, for scripts and agents
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "jr could not write its skill into $skill" }
notes: jr's agent skill is in ~\.agents\skills\jr, the cross-agent folder, and in
~\.claude\skills\jr, where Claude Code reads it, both written by the binary they
describe. 'scoop update jr' rewrites both at the new version. 'scoop uninstall jr'
leaves them. jr refuses a directory holding a file the skill does not include.
